outcome.technical: tools/release.py step_commit: removed the os.remove-before-git-rm; it now runs `git rm -q -f --ignore-unmatch -- <fragments>` first (git removes the working file with the index entry, and a refusal removes neither), returns False on failure leaving files on disk and tracked, and only after success os.removes any fragment git did not track (isfile-guarded). Red on old code, green on new. Dependants: tests/test_audit_task.py, guard-release.py, check-example-pins.py, ci.yml, sweep-costs.json etc. use release.py via import/path of other functions (release_verdict, _read_text, save_state); step_commit's signature and return shape are unchanged, so still correct. outcome.descriptive: A failed git rm in the release commit step no longer deletes the changelog fragments from disk, so a resumed release cannot commit them still tracked and assemble them twice.
